Granite Springs Asset Management LLC trimmed its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.8% during the third quarter, Holdings Channel reports. The fund owned 18,120 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 526 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 3.4% of Granite Springs Asset Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 2nd biggest holding. Granite Springs Asset Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,090,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently bought and sold shares of the business. Stillwater Capital Advisors LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 0.6% in the 3rd quarter. Stillwater Capital Advisors LLC now owns 105,760 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $23,874,000 after buying an additional 668 shares during the last quarter. Harwood Advisory Group LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 52.8% in the 3rd quarter. Harwood Advisory Group LLC now owns 17,035 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,854,000 after buying an additional 5,884 shares during the last quarter. Dock Street Asset Management Inc. boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 0.4% in the 3rd quarter. Dock Street Asset Management Inc. now owns 193,674 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $43,720,000 after buying an additional 746 shares during the last quarter. Shamrock Asset Management LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 18.3% in the 3rd quarter. Shamrock Asset Management LLC now owns 1,942 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $438,000 after buying an additional 300 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Sigma Investment Counselors Inc. boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 6.8% in the 3rd quarter. Sigma Investment Counselors Inc. now owns 41,573 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,385,000 after buying an additional 2,651 shares during the last quarter. 57.02% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. AAPL has been the topic of a number of research analyst reports. Citigroup boosted their price target on shares of Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 8th. UBS Group set a $250.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 8th. Vertical Group began coverage on Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. They issued a “sell” rating on the stock. Bank of America restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. Finally, JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 10th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the company. The stock presently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $191.66.
AAPL stock opened at $166.52 on Friday. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The company has a market capitalization of $812.23 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.98, a P/E/G ratio of 1.61 and a beta of 1.23. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $142.00 and a 1-year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. The company had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $84.07 billion. Apple had a net margin of 22.72% and a return on equity of 51.09%. As a group, sell-side analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.74 earnings per share for the current year.
The company also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be paid a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.75%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, February 8th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 24.52%.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
